decisions.reason: The conditional offer of help concerns the client-operated KDP workflow and does not change the required back matter or author biography content.
KDP workflow support does not resolve the cover-design ambiguity or change the cover visual, count, or trim-size requirements.
The offer to help if the client becomes blocked during the KDP process does not change the publication attribution line.
Conditional KDP assistance leaves the paperback format and 6 x 9 inch trim-size specification unchanged.
The source decision concerns support during the KDP workflow and does not alter any authoritative manuscript content or tracked edits.
The word support is incidental overlap; the conditional KDP guidance does not modify the copyediting goal or approved passages.
KDP workflow assistance does not change the required Chapter 18 subtitle and body-text typography.
The conditional offer of KDP help does not change image distortion, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
The KDP assistance commitment does not change chapter-image inclusion, coverage, placement, or presentation.
The source decision does not alter permitted image sources, suitability review, or image-selection criteria.
